name: samantha-social-desk-chat-pilot
description: Reel preview, optional approved media transfer and separately confirmed draft-only cover attachment in Claude Chat.

pilot_mode.title: Offline pilot mode
pilot_mode.description: Leave off for previews only. Enter mock for synthetic drafts or mock-timeout for synthetic recovery testing. No live mode exists.

approved_folder.title: Approved reel review folder (optional)
approved_folder.description: Exact read-only approved folder, including Drive for desktop synced bytes. Local reviews share captions/covers with Claude. Optional transfer sends only approved MP4/PNG pairs to Zernio after native confirmation.

approval_probe.title: Optional native approval probe
approval_probe.description: Enter on for the synthetic no-write approval probe. Leave off normally.

transfer_enabled.title: Enable approved media transfer
transfer_enabled.description: Off by default. Requires one-time private setup and native in-Chat confirmation. Transfer only; no drafts or posting.

transfer_config.title: Private transfer config
transfer_config.description: Owner-only JSON configured once by the authorized workspace operator; keep outside Drive and Git.

transfer_key.title: Dedicated Zernio credential
transfer_key.description: Enter only here, never in Chat. Use the restricted credential approved for this workspace. Publishing-group authority is broader than this extension uses.

draft_enabled.title: Enable paired draft creation
draft_enabled.description: Separately opt in after authorized setup. Native approval required for one unscheduled draft containing both pinned accounts and the paired cover. Never schedules or publishes.

draft_config.title: Private exact draft account pins
draft_config.description: Owner-only local JSON with verified profile and Instagram/Facebook account IDs, usernames and credential pin.

draft_key.title: Dedicated Zernio draft credential
draft_key.description: Sensitive field only, never Chat. This is not a vendor draft-only key: publishing authority is broader. The extension submits only explicit unscheduled drafts and needs configured account reads.
